options.content: **Recorded runs from Tiled.** Click a run to select or unfold its lane. Green success · red failed · orange aborted · blue open · yellow possibly stalled · light blue activity unknown · grey stale. panels.title: Queue
panels.description: Each RE Manager's state and running plan, for the instruments the preset shows. Progress counts the plans finished since the queue started (or since the dashboard's adapter first saw it running), against those plus the plans still queued: plans, not time; the history before the run does not count.

defaults.noValue: no RE Manager for these instruments

panels.title: Selected run
panels.description: The selected run's state (status, reason, duration, activity), then where it is: uid, root, lane, role.

defaults.noValue: no run selected, or no streams

panels.title: Run time series
panels.description: The selected run's time series view against the time since its start: the whole run, whatever the dashboard's time range.

defaults.noValue: nothing to plot (see the line above)

panels.title: Timeline
panels.description: One lane per row of the preset; a run may appear on several. Green success · red failed · orange aborted · blue open · yellow possibly stalled · light blue activity unknown · grey stale. Click a run to select it, zoom to it, or unfold its lane into one row per stream.

panels.title: Corrected curve
panels.description: The curve view of the selected processing run, or of the selected measurement's latest usable processing result, on log–log axes. The bounds are y ∓ its uncertainty. Names and units are in the line above.

defaults.noValue: nothing to plot (see the line above)

panels.title: Corrected image
panels.description: The image view of the selected processing run, or of the selected measurement's latest usable processing result: log scale, colours from the 1st to the 99.5th percentile, zero and negative values transparent.

options.content: The same result as the curve: named in the line above it.

panels.title: Related runs
panels.description: A measurement's processing runs (the latest attempt and the latest usable result marked per family), or a processing run's measurements.

panels.title: Trend: runs like the selected one
Trend: the selected run and the runs like it in range

defaults.noValue: nothing to plot (see the line above)

panels.description: The selected run's time series view over every run in range on the selected lane (the line above names it) with the same plan name and the same view: one line per field, broken between runs.

panels.title: Run metadata
panels.description: The selected run's start and stop documents, one row per key (nested keys dotted). Long values end in … where they were cut.

panels.title: Stream fields (choose a stream in Streams)
